选择反击、防御或回避。反击先选武器，再点击可选的来袭敌人；每个单位每回合只反击一: Choose counterattack, defend or evade. To counter, select a weapon and click an eligible incoming enemy. Each unit counters one target per turn.
等待所有玩家完成演出。: Waiting for every player to finish playback.
每回合只能选择一个敌人反击一次，命中率×0.75。: Counter one selected enemy once per turn. Accuracy ×0.75.

每台单位每回合可移动一次、攻击一次。反击消耗武器资源，不消耗自己的行动机会。: Each unit can move and attack once per turn. Counters consume EN but do not use an action.
点击己方单位，选择蓝色格子移动。: Select a friendly unit, then a blue tile to move.
曼哈顿格距 · 山岩与水域不可通过: Grid distance · Rocks and water are impassable
承受攻击后，以可用武器回击。: Counter with an available weapon after taking the attack. Counter accuracy is multiplied by 0.75.
受到伤害减少50%，不反击。: Take 50% less damage; do not counter.
敌方命中率降低35个百分点，不反击。: Reduce enemy accuracy by 35 percentage points; do not counter.
先攻方先结算；防守方被击破则无法反击。: The attacker fires first. A destroyed defender cannot counter.
点击己方机体或左侧头像，点击蓝色格子移动。移动可在攻击／待机前撤销。不能穿过其他: Select a friendly unit or portrait, then a blue tile to move. Undo movement before attacking or waiting. Units, rocks and water block movement.
右侧选择武器，再点红色高亮敌机，或点击目标列表。射程含最小距离；按横纵格数相加计: Choose a weapon on the right, then a highlighted enemy or target in the list. Range uses horizontal plus vertical distance, with a minimum range and no line-of-sight check.
选择反击、防御或回避。反击武器必须同时满足射程和 EN 条件。只有存活才能回击。: Choose Counter, Defend or Evade. Counter weapons must have enough EN and be in range. Only surviving units can counter.
每台单位可移动一次，然后攻击或待机。也可原地攻击。攻击后结束该单位行动；反击不消: Each unit can move once, then attack or wait, or attack without moving. An attack ends its action. Counters consume EN, not an action. Units recover 15 EN when their team starts a turn.
三种机体的贴图和骨骼动画来自MOD。数值为SLG验证配置；没有照搬官方G世纪规则: Unit art and skeletal animations come from the MOD. Stats are tuned for this tactical prototype. Technology, progression and support attacks are not implemented.
